page.title: Users
page.description: Accounts that can sign in, and the roles an administrator assigned. Last login is UTC.
page.forbidden: Your role cannot administer users (permission admin:users).

once.initial: The initial password for {name} is shown once. The account must change it at the next sign-in.
once.reset: The new password for {name} is shown once. The account must change it at the next sign-in.

outcome.createdLocal: Created local user {name}. The account must change the password at the next sign-in.
outcome.createdLdap: Pre-created LDAP user {name}. The account has no password here.
outcome.mismatch: The new password and the confirmation do not match.
outcome.resetDone: Reset the password for {name}. The account must change it at the next sign-in.

empty.title: No accounts are stored.
empty.text: Create a local account below, or pre-create a directory account so a role is in place before the first sign-in.

table.label: Accounts
table.caption: Accounts with source, display name, roles, status and last login. Times are UTC.

actions.ldapNoPassword: An LDAP account has no password here.
actions.select: Select an account to change its roles, status, or local password.

create.initialHint: Shown once after the account is created. The account must change it at the next sign-in.
create.ldapHint: The directory checks the password. This account is created here so a role can be assigned before the first sign-in.
